visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Transpose In Place
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A second matrix receives the transposed values and then they are copied back. Swap the mirrored elements in place instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: For a square matrix the transpose only needs the elements above the diagonal swapped with their mirror image. That halves the work and needs no second matrix and no copy loop.
